content:
nina: starting quick canary for stable/v2026-03-22. staged to 15% global, watching p95 + 5xx for 12m. please flag anything noisy.

deploy-bot: canary started · dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/inflight/1771234567 · p95 guard = 350ms · posting summaries every 60s.

jon: heads up — us-west p95 creeping to ~520ms at +4m, small cluster of 502s from model-worker-9.

lee: are those errors correlated with autoscaler churn or memory OOMs?

jon: seems like OOMs on quant-runner. sample: ```[2026-03-22T09:14:38Z] model-worker-9 kernel: alloc failed, oom, pid=2345 mem=1.8G```

nina: pausing ramp. do not increase traffic. propose region pin: us-west -> v2026-03-18 (fallback non-quant).

lee: agree. command: `deployctl pin --region us-west --route stable --version v2026-03-18`

jon: executed.

deploy-bot: traffic policy change applied · us-west pinned -> v2026-03-18 · global ramp lowered -> 5% · change link: https://deploy.redwood/changes/1771234567

infra-ops: inspecting limiter and kube memory requests. found quant-runner pods in us-west with memory request lower than recent kernel increase. patching helm values to bump requests for canary pool by +512Mi and rolling affected pods.

jon: after pin + bump, p95 back to ~270ms and 502s dropped to baseline. queues draining.

nina: action list: jon = collect pod oom traces and heap profiles; infra-ops = update helm canary values and add alert for quant-runner mem pressure; lee = add short entry to release notes about regional pin.

lee: created GH issue #4345 with logs and initial triage: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/4345

nina: we'll hold 30m and then try a small test ramp in non-impacted regions. do not remove pin until we confirm the memory fix and bench results.

opsbot: note: pinned stable route in us-west to v2026-03-18 by jon at 2026-03-22T09:16:10Z.

jon: thanks — rolling up the traces now. will post flamegraphs to GH.

nina: good job. let's keep the thread for any test ramps.

(quiet)
